messages:
deploy-bot: starting release wave: api@v2.3.3, runtime@v4.7-rc2, router@v3.0.3, console@v1.9.2. Change window 2025-07-02 21:00->2025-07-03 01:00 UTC. Canary 2% us-west1. Pins: runtime=4.7-rc2, router=3.0.3-canary. Rollback: error%>1% OR p95>500ms for 5m -> auto-cut.
maria: ack. Heads-up: runtime rc2 modified kv eviction default; we saw cache churn in staging. Need confirmation on TTL.
jess: api: no contract changes, but rerank/prefix caching is sensitive. If TTL short we'll observe spikes in latency and error rate.
kyle: runtime: default KV_TTL was reduced to 12s in rc2 for mem pressure. For safety I pushed an override for canary: helm values set kv.ttl="30s" on runtime-canary. Command: `helm upgrade runtime-canary chart/ --set kv.ttl=30s`
sam: console: we'll mute dashboard auto-refresh and tag dashboards with release/1765009999 for 20m. That avoids noisy alerts from transient cache misses.
oncall-sre: tightening watch: alert rule set to auto-cut if errors>0.9% for 4m or p95>480ms for 3m. First automated cut goes to fallback and notifies #incidents.
maria: please include commit SHAs in the deploy-bot post and add exact rollback commands in the release note.
deploy-bot: updated with SHAs: api@v2.3.3 -> sha: aa11bb2, runtime@v4.7-rc2 -> sha: cc33dd4, console@v1.9.2 -> sha: ee55ff6, router@v3.0.3 -> sha: gg77hh8. Canary will start in 2m.
jess: smoke tests queued: quick set for prefix-caching, long-seq, and rerank. script: `./smoke.sh --cases prefix,longseq,rerank --total 150 --rps 2`
kyle: runtime logs after override show `INFO kv ttl=30s`. No OOMs in last 5m.
oncall-sre: monitoring now. If thresholds hit we'll execute the rollback snippet below.

# cut traffic to stable fallback
kubectl -n routing exec deploy/router-controller -- ./routectl set-weight api-canary --traffic 0 && ./routectl set-weight api-stable --traffic 100
# pin runtime back
kubectl -n runtime set image sts/runtime-prod runtime=runtime:4.6.9

maria: release note draft: - kv.ttl override for canary - router header mapping update - pinned runtime/router - ramp: 2% for 20m -> 10% for 30m -> 40% for 45m -> manual gates. I'll PR to release-notes repo and close thread at 10% ramp or earlier if rollback.
